description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' built-in serializers, verifying correct serialization and deserialization of various .NET and Orleans-specific types, including complex classes, collections, structs, enums, and object references.

classes.name: BuiltInSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests to verify Orleans' built-in serialization capabilities for various data types and structures.

classes.name: BanningTypeResolver
classes.description: A custom type resolver that blocks specific types from being resolved, used in serialization tests.

methods.name: OrleansSerializationLoop
methods.description: Performs a serialization round-trip and deep copy of an object, used to test serialization correctness.

methods.name: ValidateDictionary
methods.description: Validates that a deserialized dictionary matches the source dictionary.

methods.name: ValidateDictionaryContent
methods.description: Checks that the content of a deserialized dictionary matches the source.

methods.name: ValidateReadOnlyDictionary
methods.description: Validates a read-only dictionary after deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateSortedDictionary
methods.description: Validates a sorted dictionary after deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateSortedList
methods.description: Validates a sorted list after deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateReadOnlyCollectionList
methods.description: Validates a read-only collection after deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateArrayOfArrays
methods.description: Validates a jagged array after deserialization.

methods.name: ValidateArrayOfArrayOfArrays
methods.description: Validates a 3D jagged array after deserialization.

methods.name: AreByteArraysAreEqual
methods.description: Checks if two byte arrays are equal.
